watch.title: Folder watching
watch.description: Auto-import PDFs dropped into your watched folder
watch.watchHint: When on, new PDFs in your watched subfolder are imported automatically.
watch.subdirHint: Relative to the mounted host root (/host).

engine.title: Conversion engine
engine.description: How uploaded PDFs are turned into Markdown
engine.markerUrlHint: e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000 — the marker-server base URL

off.label: Off — no conversion
off.desc: Conversion is disabled. Uploads and watched files are rejected until you pick an engine.

markerHost.label: Marker — on this server
markerHost.desc: Highest quality (OCR, tables, layout, equations) via the local marker container. Heavy: loads ~5 GB of models on first use and is CPU-intensive — best on a roomy machine.

markerRemote.label: Marker — off this server
markerRemote.desc: Use a marker server running elsewhere (e.g. your workstation). Enter its URL below. While it is offline, documents wait and auto-resume the moment it is reachable again — nothing fails.

pdfplumber.label: pdfplumber — lightweight
pdfplumber.desc: Instant, near-zero-cost text extraction for born-digital PDFs. No OCR, tables, or images — scanned/image-only PDFs will come out empty. Ideal for simple text documents on a small box.
